svg.title: A product team's release cycle
svg.desc:
A product team's release cycle Written as JSON with the ring layout. Draw it with: open-diagram draw examples/release_cycle.json States shown: Live, Being built, In trial. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Learn: Customer calls; Team retro - Measure: Usage; Error alerts (being built) - Plan: Roadmap; Pick the next bet - Product goals: Keep customers; Grow usage - Ship: Staged rollout; Release notes - Build: Write code; Code review - Test: Automated tests; Beta group (in trial) Lines: - Plan -> Build - Build -> Test - Test -> Ship - Ship -> Measure - Measure -> Learn - Learn -> Plan, labeled "next cycle"
